label: Kalender
research: iOS Calendar / Google Calendar / Fantastical on phones: a week strip (Mo–So, dots on days with entries, swipe for the next week, today highlighted) above the selected day's agenda; month = compact grid with dots, the selected day's list below; '+' creates on the selected day; filters (calendars) as a list of toggles with colours that double as the legend. Desktop keeps week/month grids. Notion Calendar / Cron: click an empty slot → create there. Taken: the phone pattern inside the shared <CalendarView> (so Schichten, Abwesenheiten, Vermietung, Aufgaben get it too), sources as a chip row with colour dots (several at once), a 'Neu am …' sheet that picks the module and passes the day. Detail views and empty days: iOS / Fantastical open an entry's details on tap (we open the record itself), an empty day says so in one line; Google Calendar's '+' on phones pre-fills the selected day; Notion Calendar / Cron show calendars as coloured toggles in a list that double as the legend.
moduleNote: Shown when any of events, shifts, projects, rentals, courses is on and the person has its .view permission (nav entry + sourcesFor()).

redesign.job: What is happening when, across everything the person may see; open it; add something on a day.
redesign.phone: Top bar 'Kalender' (round + = Neu → ?new=entry for the selected day). Chip row of sources (colour dot = legend, tap toggles). Month title with ‹ › and Heute, Woche · Monat switch. Week strip Mo–So (dots, today ring, selected filled; swipe or arrows = next week) or the month grid with dots. Below: the selected day's entries (colour bar, title, time or 'Ganztägig', › opens the record) and '+ Neu am Fr, 20. Nov.'
redesign.desktop: Header: primary 'Neu' (?new=entry). Source chips in the toolbar. CalendarView month/week/day/list grids; an empty slot opens ?new=entry for that day.
moves: FilterMenu Bereich (one source) → chip row of toggles (?src=events,shifts …), colour dot per source as the legend

primary 'Neues Event' + more (Schicht, Projekt, Kurs, Vergabe) → primary 'Neu' → ?new=entry sheet: one row per module the person may create in, each carrying the selected day (Event ?start=, Schicht ?start/&end, Aufgabe ?due=, Projekt ?start=, Vergabe ?start/&end, Kurs without date)
CalendarView month/week/day/agenda (read-only) → kept on desktop; phones get the week strip / month dots + day list (shared CalendarView)
empty slot click (none) → ?new=entry for that day
entry click → the record (kept: events, shifts, tasks, projects, rentals, courses)

sections.title: Kalender
sections.notes: CalendarView month/week/day/agenda, all entries readOnly (no drag, no slot click). Click targets: events → /events/<id>; shifts → /shifts?shift=<id>; tasks (all-day, '✓' when done) → /projects/tasks?task=<id>; projects (all-day bar start–end, project colour) → /projects/<id>; rentals → /rentals/r/<id> (short rentals as time span, long ones as all-day marks 'Mietbeginn' / 'letzter Tag für Kündigung' / 'Vertragsende'); courses (each session) → /courses/<id>. Cancelled events prefixed '✕'. Events coloured by the first select custom field with option colours.

pages.phone: Primary as round + with a glass menu of all create choices; CalendarView on phones.
uxNotes: Calendar is read-only: no drag and no click-to-create on an empty day, although the module calendars (shifts, absences, tasks) support both; the '+' menu ignores the clicked date.
Only one source can be filtered at a time (FilterMenu single value), no multi-select of sources; no legend for source colours (events can use their own custom colours too, so colours are ambiguous).
Clicking an entry leaves the calendar (navigates to the module page / opens its drawer there) instead of a preview in place.
HR absences are not a source (CALENDAR_SOURCES has no hr), so who is away doesn't show next to shifts.
'Neue Schicht' from here opens /shifts?new=shift with the default date (today 18:00), not the calendar's focused date.
